messages:
Maya (eng-sre): APAC-A warm-pool nodes failing to join after OPA push, GPUs stuck in Init.
Raj (eng-infra): any logs?
Maya (eng-sre): kubelet -> decrypt rpc PermissionDenied, and tls handshake refused to priv-keystore.
OpsBot: [ALERT] node-join-failures: 9 nodes failed in apac-a in last 4m
Priya (eng-platform): rolling rollback will spike audit churn. Is a targeted allow possible?
Lin (eng-security): policy tightened egress to keystore NLBs; looks like new ENI prefixes for warm-pool weren't included.
Raj (eng-infra): applying short-lived exception to OPA for the apac-a ENI /24 now.
Priya (eng-platform): add rationale to INC-5135 (cost + SLO risk).
Raj (eng-infra): diff:
- allow: keystore/egress
  when: src_subnet in ["10.240.99.0/24"]
  ttl: 15m
  reason: temp-warmpool-exception-apac-a
Maya (eng-sre): canary applied, first node rejoined +22s. join-rate recovering.
Lin (eng-security): opened audit entry and flagged TTL. Postmortem items: include warm-pool discovery, OPA dry-run for active ENIs, clearer keystore authz errors.
Priya (eng-platform): estimated avoided cross-region failover cost ~ $9k/day. Put that in the ticket.
Raj (eng-infra): PR to policy generator + tests: https://git.internal/r/infra/pulls/421
Maya (eng-sre): leaving exception for TTL, monitoring decrypt-error-rate and node-join. Will revoke once stable. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: [INFO] policy-exception-applied canary-id: opa-canary-83
Priya (eng-platform): will update INC-5135 with timeline and action items.
Maya (eng-sre): thanks, closing thread when exception revokes cleanly.
